opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ky. The order of October 11, 1988 [ante, p. 887], granting the petition for writ of certiorari is amended to read as follows: Motion of peti*907tioner for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certiorari granted limited to Question VIII presented by the petition and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 87-6026, Wilkins v. Missouri [certiorari granted, 487 U. S. 1233], in place of No. 87-5666, High v. Zant, Warden [certiorari granted, 487 U. S. 1233].
